title: 望秦川
author: 李颀

Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 望秦川 — 李颀
秦川朝望迥，日出正东峰。
远近山河净，逶迤城阙重。
秋声万户竹，寒色五陵松。
客有归欤叹，凄其霜露浓。
No text or tiny seal in any corner. Human anatomy natural: exactly two hands per person.
